scripts.zsh:
#compdef peer
_peer() {
  local -a commands
  commands=(
    'acp:Run the ACP agent on stdio'
    'bots:Browse bots'
    'completions:Print a shell completion script'
    'doctor:Check the local peer install'
    'exec:Run one task without the TUI'
    'export:Export a stored session as Markdown'
    'help:Show help'
    'models:List configured models'
    'result:Read an interactive result'
    'sessions:List, resume, or delete sessions'
    'update:Install the newest release on this channel'
    'version:Print the version'
  )
  if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
    _describe command commands
    _arguments '--classic[Open task mode]' '--help[Show help]' '--version[Print version]'
    return
  fi
  case "$words[2]" in
    sessions) _values action list resume delete ;;
    completions) _values shell bash zsh fish ;;
    update) _arguments '--check[Report without installing]' '--help[Show help]' ;;
    export) _arguments '--output[Write to a file]:file:_files' '--force[Overwrite]' ;;
  esac
}
if (( ${+functions[compdef]} )); then compdef _peer peer; fi
scripts.fish:
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a acp -d 'Run the ACP agent on stdio'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a bots -d 'Browse bots'

complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a doctor -d 'Check the local peer install'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a exec -d 'Run one task without the TUI'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a export -d 'Export a stored session as Markdown'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a help -d 'Show help'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a models -d 'List configured models'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a result -d 'Read an interactive result'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a sessions -d 'List, resume, or delete sessions'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a update -d 'Install the newest release on this channel'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -a version -d 'Print the version'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -l classic -d 'Open task mode'
complete -c peer -n __fish_use_subcommand -l help -d 'Show help'

help:
peer 0.1.0-rc.40

peer completions — print a shell completion script

Usage:

The script is written to stdout. This command does not edit your shell configuration.
